afternoon.special_notes: Moderate crowd; all attractions active; Bubbles-adjacent hay smell strongest during big-top feeding time. Grounds at their most family-tourist-friendly appearance before the evening crowd shifts the tone.

evening_night.special_notes: Peak crowd density. icq_backroom hotspot most active after dark - this is when Darkweb Dossier hack-through pop-ins are most likely to trigger. Calliope volume and vape-cloud density both increase slightly, per Vance's own showmanship instincts.

beatdown_filming_days.special_notes: Hamstradamus is absent from prophecy_tent, relocated to Fauxst Beach as prize-giver. shady_productions_office sees visibly increased foot traffic moving gear along the riverside path toward the Bohemian Riviera. The casting-call fax runs more frequently, though it never prints anything but the same flyer.

prophecy_tent_glow_seam_bleed.note: Exterior dressing only per Cirque_du_Shady_PNG_Assets.md - does not modify or duplicate Hamstradamus's own interior/performer animation states, which remain fully owned by hamstradamus.md.

permanent_details.description: Small taped-on addendum beneath the 5 Sovs admission sign, clearly added later: '(THIS INCLUDES THE BATHROOM.)'
Rust rings on the big top's support pole, marking where wheels used to attach before the tent stopped traveling
Shrink-wrapped merchandise pallet stamped 2003 at the tent-flap edge of shady_productions_office, same physical stock as the Bohemian Riviera's pallet split across two storage locations
Hand-lettered sign taped to the fax machine: 'SHADY PRODUCTIONS - HOME OF THE BACCHANUS BEACH BEATDOWN - SEASON 22'

dynamic_details.description: The fax machine periodically spits an identical Casting-Call Flyer, un-collated copies stacking on the folding table
A single CRT monitor glow visible through the propped-open flap after dark, primary readability cue for the hack-through event
